metadata.title: ADB-Channel Formal Contract & Historical Evidence Errata
metadata.description: Formally supersedes preliminary Phase 2C.5A claims regarding adb-channel downstream topology and inbound channel options, and refines ADB-B6F-01 evidence classification into cross-component parity while preserving historical artifact immutability.

superseded_historical_artifacts.superseded_claim: adb-channel target downstream: 'Local ADB daemon / 127.0.0.1:5555 / reverse shell'
adb-channel target / subsystem: 'Reverse shell / local ADB daemon bridge'

errata_principles: Historical Phase 2C.5A artifacts remain strictly immutable on disk.
Base contract ADB_CHANNEL_B6F_IMPLEMENTATION_CONTRACT.json remains strictly frozen and immutable with SHA256 1b1aba53ef39786fadafaab772e11c0611198403f8910f951a507ff4b06fc3ea.
Exhaustive binary callgraph analysis across ARM64 and AMD64 proves zero reachable net.Dial/net.DialTCP calls, zero constructed socket paths, and zero occurrences of '127.0.0.1:5555'.

The authentic original downstream topology is an in-process PTY shell allocation (/dev/ptmx via pty.Open with non-PTY pipe shell fallback) spawning /system/bin/sh (ARM64) or /bin/sh (AMD64) with background goroutines pumping stdout -> (*DataChannel).Send.

Inbound 'ordered: true' property is classified as REFERENCE_ONLY from frontend browser creation (pc.createDataChannel('adb-channel', { ordered: true })), as original Agent binary does not enforce or inspect the ordered flag on inbound channels.

Channel identity (ADB-B6F-01) is split into Agent inbound acceptance (STATIC_CONFIRMED) and Browser client creation (REFERENCE_INTEROPERABILITY), yielding effective classification CROSS_COMPONENT_CONFIRMED.
All process execution, PTY allocation, and shell streaming logic are classified as DEFERRED_ADB_BRIDGE_BOUNDARY and excluded from clean-room agent runtime implementation.

corrections.superseded_claim: adb-channel bridges to an external local ADB daemon at 127.0.0.1:5555 over TCP socket
corrections.problem: Phase 2C.5A preliminary documentation assumed an external ADB daemon bridge based on standard Android cloud patterns. However, exhaustive callgraph disassembly of both ARM64 and AMD64 binaries proves zero net.Dial calls reachable from adb-channel, zero TCP socket logic, and zero occurrences of '127.0.0.1:5555' in binary rodata/symbols.
corrections.supporting_original_evidence: Reachable call graph from ARM64 0x516020 and AMD64 0x9b2be0 contains 0 net.Dial calls; strings '127.0.0.1:5555' and '5555' TCP endpoints absent.
corrections.corrected_original_claim: The original Agent embeds an in-process ADB-packet compatible handler and PTY reverse-shell boundary spawning local shell (/system/bin/sh or /bin/sh). No external TCP ADB daemon connection exists.

corrections.superseded_claim: adb-channel ordered=true is an Agent-side static protocol guarantee
corrections.problem: The ordered=true configuration is specified exclusively on the browser client during pc.createDataChannel('adb-channel', { ordered: true }). The Agent binary accepts the channel via pc.OnDataChannel and never inspects or enforces the (*DataChannel).Ordered() flag.
corrections.supporting_original_evidence: ARM64 OnDataChannel (0x53f210) and AMD64 OnDataChannel (0x9e2f20) call (*DataChannel).Label() only; (*DataChannel).Ordered() is never called.
corrections.corrected_original_claim: Channel ordered property is a browser client creation property (REFERENCE_ONLY) and does not constitute an Agent-side static parity requirement.

corrections.superseded_claim: Channel label is 'adb-channel' (11 bytes), created by Browser Client and accepted inbound by Agent in pc.OnDataChannel (STATIC_CONFIRMED, mandatory_for_parity: true)
corrections.problem: Channel label comparison 'adb-channel' and inbound acceptance via pc.OnDataChannel are authentic original Agent binary static facts (STATIC_CONFIRMED). However, 'created by Browser Client' originates from client-side WebRTC construction in frontend Lane D reference (pc.createDataChannel('adb-channel', { ordered: true })). Attributing the entire composite requirement to pure original static evidence overcounts Agent static parity.

split_effective_semantics.original_static_part: Agent receives an inbound DataChannel through pc.OnDataChannel, performs label comparison proving 'adb-channel' (ARM64 0x53f2ac, AMD64 0x9e2fad), and consumes the matched channel.
split_effective_semantics.reference_interoperability_part: Browser Client creates the DataChannel with label 'adb-channel' via pc.createDataChannel('adb-channel', ...).

corrections.corrected_original_parity_claim: Agent receives inbound DataChannel via pc.OnDataChannel, compares label 'adb-channel', and routes to dedicated adb handler.
corrections.non_original_compatibility_behavior: Browser Client initiates the WebRTC DataChannel with label 'adb-channel' (REFERENCE_INTEROPERABILITY).
corrections.rationale: Separates Agent binary inbound consumption (STATIC_CONFIRMED) from Browser client channel creation (REFERENCE_INTEROPERABILITY), classifying the composite channel identity requirement as CROSS_COMPONENT_CONFIRMED.
